apps.name: Open CAD Studio
apps.description: Open-source 2D drafting and 3D modeling in Rust, with DWG and DXF support.
notes: The project's own website extras (supporter list, videos) are left out of this copy.

apps.name: vcad
apps.description: Open-source parametric CAD for the AI era: sketching, assemblies and simulation.
notes: Sign-in, cloud sync and AI features are not set up in this hosted copy. The app runs on its own.

apps.name: OpenPencil
apps.description: Open-source design editor that opens Figma .fig files, with built-in AI.
notes: Usage pings are switched off in this copy.

apps.name: OpenRSCAD
apps.description: A fast, from-scratch Rust reimplementation of the OpenSCAD language, with a live playground.

apps.name: Blender in the Browser
apps.description: The real Blender, compiled to WebAssembly with a WebGPU backend (Puter Labs). Needs a WebGPU browser.
notes: Needs a browser with WebGPU. The first launch downloads about 60 MB.
apps.noMirror: Puter publishes a single browser build and no older versions.

apps.name: Hew
apps.description: Free, open-source, solids-first 3D modeler in the SketchUp style. Opens and saves SketchUp .skp files.
apps.license: AGPL-3.0 with the Hew Plugin API Exception
notes: Opens and saves .skp files in the current SketchUp format and the 2017 one.
Hew also has native apps for macOS, Windows and Linux; this is its browser version.

apps.name: Honeydew
apps.description: A clean-room reimplementation of FL Studio Mobile in Rust: piano roll, drums, mixer and effects, running in the browser and natively.
notes: Opens FL Studio Mobile .flm projects. Also runs natively on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android.
apps.noMirror: Each browser build is about 1.4 GB, far more than a GitHub Pages site can hold.

apps.name: PhotoSplice
apps.description: An image editor that faithfully recreates the classic, CS6-era Photoshop feel, with full PSD and PSB round-tripping. Built in Rust on the PhotoCraft engine.
notes: Also available as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux.
apps.noMirror: The author publishes only desktop installers for old versions; there is no browser build to host.

apps.name: Lemon Studio
apps.description: A pattern-based digital audio workstation written in Rust, with a step sequencer, piano roll, playlist and mixer. It opens and saves FL Studio projects and hosts plugins on the desktop.
notes: Runs in the browser through a WebAssembly port by daijro (github.com/daijro/Lemon-Studio-web). The project itself is also a native app for Windows, Linux and macOS.
Pre-alpha. Opens projects saved by FL Studio 24.2 or later.

apps.name: NoteCraft
apps.description: A OneNote-style notebook in Rust, with an Office-style ribbon, nested notebooks, sections and pages.
notes: Early preview. Runs in the browser through daijro's playground, built from the project's latest code.
apps.noMirror: The project publishes no browser build (only desktop downloads). daijro's playground compiles one from the latest code with its own patches, so there are no older web versions to host.

apps.name: MailCraft
apps.description: A classic-Outlook-style mail, calendar, contacts and tasks app in Rust, with a ribbon, reading pane and rules.
notes: Early preview. Other projects are also called MailCraft; this is MonkeySaint's.

apps.noMirror: getcadcraft.com keeps every version of this app online, so we link to those instead of keeping copies.

apps.name: Extrudo

apps.name: Graphite
apps.description: A free, open-source vector graphics editor and animation engine with a nondestructive, node-based workflow.
notes: In alpha.
apps.noMirror: The project publishes no browser releases (the author's site only serves the newest version), so there are no older web builds to download and host.

apps.name: Doory
apps.description: Design cards, posts, slides and posters in your browser, free with no sign-up, no watermark and no ads.
apps.noMirror: The project publishes no browser releases (the author's site only serves the newest version), so there are no older web builds to download and host.

apps.name: RustGIS
apps.description: A fast, free and open-source GIS in pure Rust, with a ribbon interface, a layers pane, over 1,000 analysis tools and an optional AI assistant.
notes: Also available as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux.
The AI assistant needs your own API key or sign-in with the model provider you choose; the rest of the app needs no account.
apps.noMirror: The author's site serves only the newest version, and the project's releases carry only desktop and Python packages, so we have no older web builds.

apps.name: Pro-Wave
apps.description: A Logic Pro-style music production workstation in Rust, with tracks, MIDI and audio regions, a piano roll, a mixer and a built-in synth.
notes: Early development. Runs in the browser through daijro's playground, built from the project's latest code.
Also available as a desktop app.
apps.noMirror: The project publishes no browser build (only desktop downloads). daijro's playground compiles one from the latest code with its own patches, so there are no older web versions to host.

apps.name: TraceDraw
apps.description: A clean-room vector editor in pure Rust for illustration, page layout and print, with pages and layers, node editing, live effects, PDF/X export and .cdr file support.
notes: Alpha: expect bugs.
Also available as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux.

apps.name: FireCraft
apps.description: A clean-room Adobe Fireworks CS6 reimplementation in pure Rust: hybrid vector and bitmap web design with .fw.png documents, symbols, scripting and export to SVG, PSD, GIF and WebP.
notes: Also available as desktop and command-line downloads.

apps.name: Nerthus
apps.description: A clean-room reimplementation of Gaea 2 in Rust: a node-based terrain generator that builds heightfields, masks and colour maps, and opens and saves Gaea .terrain projects.
notes: Also available as desktop downloads for Windows, macOS and Linux.

apps.name: Paint.RS
apps.description: A clean-room reimplementation of Paint.NET in Rust, with layers, adjustments, effects and plugins.
notes: Also runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux.

apps.name: paint.js
apps.description: A JavaScript port of Paint.NET with layers, effects, drawing tools, selections and broad image-format support.
notes: Based on Paint.NET 3.36.7, with the interface and behavior following Paint.NET 5.1.12 and later.
Also available as desktop apps for Linux and macOS.
The Paint.NET name and artwork keep their original licenses; see the project's LICENSE.md.
apps.noMirror: The project publishes no browser build with its releases (only desktop downloads), and paintjs.net serves only the newest version, so there are no web builds of older versions to copy.
